nativePitch.statusNote: Native LIVE_MONO and LIVE_POLY use one bounded pitch processor. trackId 0 preserves the legacy route on the summed playback bus after the shared A-D bank; trackId 1-5 processes only that loop before it is mixed with other playback, before that track's independent A-D chain and the shared playback mix chain. Live monitoring/recording, input FX, rhythm, and global output stages remain outside the pitch path. Reverse playback and a selected loop no longer than the configured latency fall back dry. HQ_RENDER uses a metadata preflight, audio-callback-pinned loop snapshot, and optional C++ Rubber Band offline renderer; WAV encoding occurs in the UI.
